fixes.behavior: Preserve surface tokens and add conservative English singular forms during lexical indexing and querying.
fixes.safety_boundary: No synonym expansion and no authorization changes.

fixes.behavior: Separate leading version qualifiers, strip trailing two-version scope from requested outputs, and split put/place-X-next-to-Y constructions into two output requirements.
fixes.safety_boundary: Every requested output remains mandatory; qualifiers cannot satisfy output requirements.

fixes.behavior: Give multiple explicit versions CROSS_VERSION precedence and retrieve inactive versions for authorized unnumbered HISTORICAL_ONLY scope.
fixes.safety_boundary: Tenant, region, and ACL filters remain upstream and mandatory; historical scope admits only inactive versions.

fixes.behavior: Losslessly broadcast a singleton document identity only when every cited chunk validates to that same document.
fixes.safety_boundary: Chunk, version, authorization, span, and document identity validation remain fail-closed.

fixes.behavior: Treat complete nonempty authorized requirement packets as evidence availability for suspicious-abstain routing through the existing Sol policy.
fixes.safety_boundary: No answer is promoted directly; empty packets still safe-abstain and Sol output remains subject to all deterministic gates.
